title: test_session_start_picks_up_closed_sessions_only proves the launcher does not wait without a wall-clock bound
goal: test_session_start_picks_up_closed_sessions_only asserts that the SessionStart launch returned before the distill wrote its run file (the distill settles LAUNCH_SETTLE_S first), not that it returned within 1.5 s of wall clock, which a loaded 6-vCPU container missed (6.0 s, exit 0); the launcher's own budget stays held by test_launch_itself_fits_its_share_of_the_budget, and a planted launch that runs the distill itself fails the new check.
